The following are proposed commands and payloads, not execution results. Use `/workspace/project` throughout; preserve `WAVE_BASE_SHA=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`.

### 1. Initial wave dispatch (steps 2–3)

Before dispatch: start the implement phase, mark existing task indices 1 then 2 `in_progress`, and run the prescribed installed-package preflight against pi-cohort 7.4.3. Stop on any preflight error. The ownership paths are disjoint.

```bash
git -C /workspace/project rev-parse HEAD
# Require the supplied WAVE_BASE_SHA.
mkdir -p /tmp/reports
```

Here, implementer schema means an object requiring `status`, with allowed values `DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | NEEDS_CONTEXT | BLOCKED`.

```ts
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [
    {
      parallel: [
        {
          agent: "implementer", as: "impl_1",
          outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
          output: "/tmp/reports/wave1-task1.md",
          task: "<FULL TASK 1 + implementer prompt + unchanged Files/Tests/Spec anchors + task-1 SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS + status protocol>. Own src/parse.ts. pi-cohort saves your report; do not write the output file yourself."
        },
        {
          agent: "implementer", as: "impl_2",
          outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
          output: "/tmp/reports/wave1-task2.md",
          task: "<FULL TASK 2 + implementer prompt + unchanged Files/Tests/Spec anchors + task-2 SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS + status protocol>. Own src/format.ts. pi-cohort saves your report; do not write the output file yourself."
        }
      ],
      worktree: true,
      concurrency: 4,
      stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] }
    },
    {
      parallel: [
        {
          agent: "spec-reviewer", as: "sr_1",
          cwd: "{outputs.impl_1.treePath}",
          output: "/tmp/reports/wave1-sr1.md",
          acceptance: { level: "none", reason: "Parent reads Verdict; review tree is staged by design." },
          task: "<FULL TASK 1 + SR PROMPT + unchanged Spec anchors, Tests block and Test paths>. Authoritative spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/feature.md. Patch: {outputs.impl_1.patchPath}; already applied here. Read /tmp/reports/wave1-task1.md. Start from diff hunks with file:line; read every touched file fully; read deletions from 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Never run tests."
        },
        {
          agent: "spec-reviewer", as: "sr_2",
          cwd: "{outputs.impl_2.treePath}",
          output: "/tmp/reports/wave1-sr2.md",
          outputMode: "file-only",
          acceptance: { level: "none", reason: "Parent reads Verdict; review tree is staged by design." },
          task: "<Same SR contract, using FULL TASK 2, its unchanged anchors/Tests/Test paths>. Authoritative spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/feature.md. Patch: {outputs.impl_2.patchPath}; already applied here. Read /tmp/reports/wave1-task2.md. Read touched files fully, deletions from WAVE_BASE_SHA; never run tests."
        }
      ],
      concurrency: 4
    }
  ]
})
```

No SR schema, `stopOn`, or `worktree`; SR `cwd` overrides invocation `cwd`.

### 2. Consume supplied outcomes; repair task 2 only

Read implementer statuses from fenced JSON in `## Outputs` and any `## Stop`. Both are supplied as `DONE`. Read reports, not SR JSON or its inline pointer:

```bash
cat /tmp/reports/wave1-sr1.md
cat /tmp/reports/wave1-sr2.md
```

Preserve task 1’s patch and `COMPLIANT` verdict. Task 2’s `NEEDS_REWORK` (“FAIL”) triggers fix 1, not a structured stop condition. Preserve its complete report verbatim.

Reconstruct task 2’s original snapshot:

```bash
SR_ROOT=/workspace/project
SR_BASE=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
SR_PATCH=/tmp/chain-run/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-1-implementer.patch
SR_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
SR_TREE="$SR_DIR/tree"
git -C "$SR_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$SR_TREE" "$SR_BASE" || exit 1
git -C "$SR_TREE" apply --index "$SR_PATCH" || exit 1
printf 'snapshot: %s\n' "$SR_TREE"
```

Run this complete capture block in that printed checkout; save SHA as task-2 tree-before:

```bash
FD_ROOT='<printed absolute snapshot path>'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Remove this reconstruction after capture. Dispatch no second chain:

```ts
subagent({
  async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  worktree: true,
  tasks: [{
    agent: "implementer",
    task: "<FULL TASK 2 + original artifact patch + complete SR2 report verbatim + task-2 SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS + status/test-contract protocol>. Repair only task 2."
  }]
})
```

### 3. Replacement re-review and later gates

For an accepted replacement, materialize its returned artifact patch using the snapshot block above, still from the fixed base. Capture tree-after using the complete capture block. Setup/capture failure stops dispatch and retains diagnostics.

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary '<tree-before>' '<tree-after>'
```

Empty delta: no re-review; resend the report noting “your fix changed no tracked file,” under the two-attempt limit.

Otherwise dispatch foreground, fresh-context SR with `cwd` equal to the replacement snapshot; no isolation flag or acceptance field. Payload: full task 2, replacement diff, absolute spec, unchanged anchors/Tests/Test paths, **no test commands**, plus:

```text
## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
<COMPLETE SR2 REPORT VERBATIM>
<VERBATIM SR TRAJECTORY TEMPLATE>
## Fix delta
<binary tree-to-tree diff>
```

Save/read its terminal report before removing the snapshot. Apply fix-loop trajectory rules if issues remain.

Only after task 2 is compliant, integrate task 1’s preserved patch and task 2’s replacement serially with `git apply --index`; run the union scoped gate. After passing, stage all deliverables, capture the review tree, and dispatch one wave CR: `cwd: /workspace/project`, `BASE_SHA: 111…111`, `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE`, union `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS`.

Do not commit before acceptance. CR findings require in-place repair and re-review; behaviour-changing fixes route through SR first. Only accepted gates permit one folded wave commit and completion of both tracker indices. No later verdict is assumed here.
